item.title: AI got the blame for the Iran school bombing. The truth is more worrying
item.description:
📝 The targeting for Operation Epic Fury ran on a system called Maven. Nobody was arguing about Maven. By the start of the Iran war, Maven – the system that had enabled that speed – had sunk into the plumbing, it had become part of the military’s infrastructure, and the argument was all about Claude.
🔗 Read more: https://www.theguardian.com/news/2026/mar/26/ai-got-the-blame-for-the-iran-school-bombing-the-truth-is-far-more-worrying

item.title: PyPI package telnyx has been compromised in yet another supply chain attack
item.description:
📝 Attackers exfiltrated credentials from every CI/CD pipeline running Trivy without version pinning. March 27 (today): Telnyx. Just import telnyx and the malware runs.
🔗 Read more: https://www.aikido.dev/blog/telnyx-pypi-compromised-teampcp-canisterworm

item.title: Iran-linked hackers have breached FBI director's personal emails
item.description:
📝 The hackers have published a series of photos of Patel from before he became FBI director that they claim were stolen from his personal email account. Reuters first reported the breach of Patel’s email on Friday. Digital security The Middle East Federal agencies National security See all topics Facebook Tweet Email Link Threads Link Copied.

item.title: Apple says no one using Lockdown Mode has been hacked with spyware
item.description:
📝 Patrick Wardle, an Apple cybersecurity expert and critic, says that Lockdown Mode is an important feature that makes it more difficult for spyware makers to attack Apple users. Contact Us Do you have more information about spyware attacks, or spyware makers. It’s possible that Lockdown Mode has been bypassed, and neither Apple nor independent investigators have caught the attack.
🔗 Read more: https://techcrunch.com/2026/03/27/apple-says-no-one-using-lockdown-mode-has-been-hacked-with-spyware/

item.title: Should QA exist?
item.description:
📝 Should engineering organizations have quality assurance (QA). Everyone on the team would know that engineering owns quality. Have engineering own quality If you do have QA, I believe it’s best to still have engineering “own” quality.
🔗 Read more: https://www.rubick.com/should-qa-exist/

item.description:
